text: {"kind":"final","content":"{\"answer\":\"The data shows today’s on-time rate is 71.0%. There are 48,340 deliveries, 14,019 late, penalties of $872,460 and handling cost of $476,646. 67.3% of late deliveries share a cause before pickup.\\nKey causes (count and late rate): Incomplete address at intake 5994, 64.6%; Same-day orders after 8am cut-off 4826, 61.0%; Shipped from a non-nearest warehouse 6700, 49.9%; Nearest warehouse out of stock 6009, 50.0%; Bad carrier lane or D on a Friday 10,030, 45.4%; Route >20% over plan 2880, 62.6%.\\nReplays show the best effects each change can achieve on the full dataset: fixing route overruns only would raise on-time to 73.6%; fixing carrier lanes only to 77.4%; fixing both carrier lanes + routes to 80.4%; fixing address + cut-off + stock to 87.8%.\\nSuggestion (from the data, not a decision): Address + cut-off + stock gives the higher on-time rate (87.8%) than carrier lanes + routes (80.4%), so the data points to fixing intake, cut-off and stock issues first. What would change that conclusion is if adoption of those fixes fell well below the assumed levels or if new lane fixes became substantially larger in scope. The decision stays with Halcyon.\",\"refused\":false}"}
